lodo.rule: If any leave-one-date-out pooled lift reverses sign and main gate passes, record V4_MODEL_OOS_ACCEPT_WITH_TEMPORAL_FRAGILITY_FLAG. It does not override the main gate.

p50_reference_classifier_diagnostic.rule: P(actual_top3) >= 0.50; max 3 selected; sort by P DESC, shadow_ai_rank ASC, horse_number ASC

eligible_race: both current and V4 sides have at least one valid_result=true evaluable horse
primary_benchmark.invalid_result: valid_result=false is excluded symmetrically; a race with all current BUY invalid is ineligible
primary_benchmark.metric: V4_SELECTION_LIFT = V4 same-volume selected BUY_TOP3_RATE - current BUY_TOP3_RATE, horse-level valid denominator
primary_benchmark.name: CURRENT_BUY_RACE_RESELECTION_BENCHMARK
primary_benchmark.selection: Within Top5, select exactly N horses by V4 P(actual_top3) DESC
